# starrocks_resource_group (Data Source)

Reads metadata for a StarRocks resource group via `SHOW RESOURCE GROUP`. Note: `cpu_weight`, `exclusive_cpu_cores`, `cpu_core_limit`, `max_cpu_cores`, and classifiers are not available through `SHOW RESOURCE GROUP` without a specific parsing layer, so only the fields StarRocks returns numerically are exposed here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "starrocks_resource_group" "example" {
  name = "my_resource_group"
}

output "mem_limit" {
  value = data.starrocks_resource_group.example.mem_limit
}

output "concurrency_limit" {
  value = data.starrocks_resource_group.example.concurrency_limit
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The resource group name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `big_query_cpu_second_limit` (Number) Maximum CPU seconds for big queries.
- `big_query_mem_limit` (Number) Memory limit in bytes for big queries.
- `big_query_scan_rows_limit` (Number) Maximum scan rows for big queries.
- `concurrency_limit` (Number) Maximum query concurrency for the resource group.
- `mem_limit` (String) Memory limit as reported by StarRocks (e.g. `"80.0%"`).
